_doc: Configuração do pipeline ElevenLabs (tools/elevenlabs_gen.py). voice_id vazio = rode 'design' e 'save' para criar a voz, ou cole o id de uma voz da Voice Library.

voice_design.preview_text: Por favor, me escuta. A gente não tem muito tempo. Se você sair por aquela porta agora, talvez nunca mais volte. Eu tô pedindo... fica comigo.

rafael.description: Brazilian Portuguese man, early 30s, office worker from São Paulo, nervous and fast-talking, slightly hoarse, natural and casual, close microphone.

jorge.description: Brazilian Portuguese man, late 50s, building security guard, deep gravelly voice, tired but firm, working-class Rio accent.

patricia.description: Brazilian Portuguese woman, around 40, accountant, frightened and breathless, voice trembling, on the verge of crying.

marina.description: Brazilian Portuguese woman, mid 30s, nurse and mother, warm and soft voice, calm under pressure, intimate tone as if speaking to her husband.

bia.description: Little girl's voice speaking Brazilian Portuguese, about 7 years old, sweet, scared, whispering.
bia._obs: Voice Design bloqueia vozes infantis. Usando a voz pronta "Jessica" (jovem, suave) da biblioteca; troque o voice_id se quiser.

tv.description: Brazilian Portuguese TV news anchor, male, 45, formal broadcast voice, clear diction, becoming increasingly alarmed.
